content.text: We are delighted to announce that as of 1 February 2021, the managing partner of our Firm,
, has been recognised by the Permanent Arbitration Court of the Hungarian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (HCCI) on its permanent Arbitrator Recommendation List of 2021-2024.

is compiled by a prestigious panel of senior academics and lawyers based on professional recommendations and includes Hungarian and foreign arbitrators with industry leading legal, economic and other professional expertise.

To be invited to join the Arbitrator Recommendation List of 2021-2024 is a well-earned recognition of Dr. Tibor Bihary's exceptional work over the course of his 30 year career as a lawyer and his experience as an ad-hoc arbitrator.
